source_handle: *28 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection and local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine were performed. After the anesthesia took effect, the gums were separated, the teeth were loosened, and the affected teeth were completely extracted. The extraction socket was reset, and cotton ball compression was used to stop bleeding.
